# Unlimited — Andrea Fan

> Andrea Fan's bilingual personal website, with software engineering articles, projects, and a resume in English and Traditional Chinese.

## English

- [Home](https://shanlefan.com/en): Introduction and recent work.
- [Blog](https://shanlefan.com/en/blog): Published software engineering articles.
- [Topics](https://shanlefan.com/en/blog/tags): Articles grouped by tag.
- [Resume](https://shanlefan.com/en/resume): Professional experience.

## Traditional Chinese

- [首頁](https://shanlefan.com/zh-TW): 個人介紹與近期作品。
- [部落格](https://shanlefan.com/zh-TW/blog): 已發布的軟體工程文章。
- [文章標籤](https://shanlefan.com/zh-TW/blog/tags): 依標籤瀏覽文章。
- [履歷](https://shanlefan.com/zh-TW/resume): 工作經歷。

## Site resources

- [Sitemap](https://shanlefan.com/sitemap.xml): Canonical URLs and available language variants.
